nodes.label: La Nube — Physical Building Exterior (Corner Facade)
nodes.description: Exterior photograph of the La Nube coworking/innovation space building. A low-rise, modern institutional building situated on a street corner in a Latin American urban setting. The facade features exposed concrete panels on the left wing and orange/terracotta-painted masonry on the right wing. The main entrance is centered, marked by a glass-and-metal door with a wheelchair-accessible ramp and handrails. A prominent sign reading 'La Nube' with its logo is mounted above the entrance. The building is single-story, set back slightly from the sidewalk with small landscaping. Utility poles and wires are visible in the background against a clear blue sky, with palm and other trees nearby.
